channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Proposta dos candidatos para crédito levam a juros maiores
item.description: Lula advocates for an expansive credit policy, while Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniella Marques propose using Caixa to increase credit access. These proposals may lead to higher interest rates.

item.title: Uso de IA, reajuste para servidores, concursos e privatizações colocam Lula e Flávio em lados opostos
item.description: Lula and Flávio hold opposing views on administrative reform, privatizations, and AI policies in the public sector, reflecting distinct positions on economy and public management. Their proposals place the candidates on opposite sides in the 2026 electoral debate.

item.title: O Bolsa Família na reta final da eleição - O Assunto #1829
item.description: The Bolsa Família program, created in 2003 to combat poverty in Brazil, returned to electoral rhetoric between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, who propose distinct changes regarding benefit values and eligibility rules. According to an FGV study, 85% of formal jobs created since 2023 were filled by program beneficiaries, highlighting its role in social inclusion and local economic development.

item.title: Plenário do TSE mantém remoção de post que associa Flávio à "rachadinha"
item.description: The TSE plenary unanimously upheld the removal of social media posts linking senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to 'Operation Unha e Carne' due to lack of factual evidence. The ruling reinforces the protection of candidates' images against unsubstantiated accusations during the electoral campaign.

item.title: Lula envia ao Congresso nesta quarta PEC que prevê tarifa zero para ônibus aos finais de semana
item.description: President Lula sends to Congress a constitutional amendment bill establishing free public transport on weekends, funded by cutting parliamentary amendments. The measure expands benefits set by the amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule and is part of a wave of popular announcements in the final stretch of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula sanciona nesta quarta lei que prevê perdão de dívidas e aumento do teto de faturamento para MEI
item.description: President Lula signed the law creating the Prospera MEI program, offering debt forgiveness, raising the revenue ceiling to R$140,000 by 2028, and allowing two employees per microentrepreneur. The measure benefits over 17.6 million MEIs with an estimated fiscal impact of R$3.38 billion in 2029.

item.title: Qual é o número de Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência da República
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL candidate for Brazil's presidency, has the ballot number 22. The October 25 election will determine the office, with voting order varying by state. The TSE confirms 158.7 million eligible voters.

item.title: Qual é o número de Lula, candidato do PT à Presidência da República
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, PT candidate for re-election to the Presidency, has the ballot number 13. In the second round on October 25, the ballot will display only two options (president and governor in some states), with 158.7 million eligible voters registered with the TSE.

item.title: Quaest divulga nova pesquisa presidencial nesta quarta-feira (21)
item.description: Quaest releases a presidential poll for the 2026 runoff, showing a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula. Datafolha will publish its own poll on Thursday.

item.title: De Bolsa Família à maioridade penal: veja o que Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula mudaram em seus discursos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula shifted stances on issues like Bolsa Família and juvenile justice during the 2026 campaign, signaling political repositioning. Flávio now supports the social program after previous criticisms, while Lula backs lowering the age of criminal responsibility for serious crimes, reversing his progressive stance. These changes reflect ideological adjustments tailored to electoral dynamics.

item.title: Campanha petista tenta convencer Lula a entrar no canal de WhatsApp comandado por Janones
item.description: Members of Lula's campaign are trying to convince him to join the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', created by André Janones and followed by nearly 6.5 million people. Despite the surge in digital engagement, Lula remains hesitant and has not yet fulfilled his promise to buy a phone once the group reached 5 million followers.

item.title: Advogado Willer Tomaz foi o maior apostador do Brasil em 2025, aponta Secretaria de Apostas
item.description: The Secretariat of Prizes and Bets identified lawyer Willer Tomaz as Brazil's top bettor in 2025 with $1 billion in bets, raising money laundering suspicions due to high-volume transactions and suspicious patterns.

item.title: Escritório de Flávio emitiu R$ 13,7 milhões em notas sem detalhar serviços
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) law firm issued BRL 13.7 million in invoices between January 2023 and July 2025, many without specifying services rendered, during his Senate term and pre-presidential campaign. Clients include companies like Sam's, Inovaconnect, and figures linked to investigated companies. The invoices only mention legal fees or counsel without clear transactions or explanations.

item.title: "Exército do Lula" ultrapassa 6 milhões de seguidores a 5 dias do 2º turno
item.description: The WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', managed by federal deputy André Janones, surpassed 6 million followers five days before the second round of the presidential election. Janones celebrated the growth and announced the channel will remain closed until it reaches 7 million subscribers, promising to mathematically prove Lula's reelection. The group was used to mobilize supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Juristas e ex-ministros do STF assinam manifesto pela Constituição e democracia
item.description: Over 600 jurists and former STF ministers have signed a manifesto defending the Constitution and democracy in Brazil. The document includes lawyers, professors, and public figures concerned with preserving democratic institutions.

item.title: A mentira do padrão Einstein
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed during a Band debate that the SUS would follow the 'Einstein standard' under his government, a promise labeled as a lie and disrespectful. The SUS, Brazil's public health system, differs from the standard of the Israelita Albert Einstein Hospital, a private institution. The statement was criticized for ignorance or intentional deception, emphasizing the importance of the SUS for the population.

item.title: Apesar de críticas ao PT, músico faz campanha pela reeleição de Lula
item.description: Despite criticism of the PT, an orchestra musician launches a public campaign supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's 2026 re-election, risking retaliation for his political stance. His action highlights the polarization and pressure faced by artists linked to public institutions when taking partisan positions.

item.title: Lula mantém liderança sobre Flávio Bolsonaro em índice de popularidade digital após debate
item.description: Lula maintains digital popularity lead over Flávio Bolsonaro following Band presidential debate. The election takes place in 2026.

item.title: Gilmar pede atenção da Justiça Eleitoral a “abusos” das big techs
item.description: STF Minister Gilmar Mendes warned Electoral Justice about potential abuses by big techs, particularly Meta, in the 2026 elections, emphasizing equal treatment for candidates. He highlighted the approval of the ECA Digital and stressed the importance of parties and platforms correcting content reach fluctuations during electoral periods.

item.title: Flávio recebeu R$ 4 milhões de advogado que buscava votos no Senado
item.description: The law firm of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) received R$4 million from Edvaldo Nilo's firm, which was seeking votes in the Senate for his reappointment to the National Public Ministry Council (CNMP). Both firms issued invoices of R$2 million each in August and October 2025, months before Flávio voted in favor of Nilo's reappointment in the Senate.

item.title: PF aponta que Willer Tomaz pagou para retirar do ar notícias que citavam relação com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Brazilian Federal Police indicate that Willer Tomaz, a friend of senator Flávio Bolsonar o, paid a company to remove online news linking him to the presidential candidate. Seized messages and documents show the hiring of a negative content removal service, with R$12,000 paid for 12 links. The case is under analysis in an inquiry at the Supreme Federal Court under Minister Alexandre de Moraes' jurisdiction.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro volta a acionar Nunes Marques diretamente sobre ‘Exército de Lula’; PT contesta pedido
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a new motion with TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques, demanding Meta explain why no coordinated behavior was detected in the 'Exército de Lula' channel. The PT's legal team argues the TSE is not the proper venue for such oversight, claiming search trends do not constitute offensive or regulated content. The matter remains under review by Electoral Court Correlate Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva following suspension requests and interim rulings issued by the TSE president.

item.title: A 5 dias do 2º turno, Gilmar Mendes e Motta fazem defesa da democracia
item.description: STF Minister Gilmar Mendes and Chamber President Hugo Motta defended democracy during speeches at the 29th International Constitutional Law Congress, emphasizing the importance of preserving the Rule of Law regardless of the outcome of the presidential runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The statements were made five days before the election that could elect Flávio Bolsonaro, convicted for attempting a coup d'état in 2022.

item.title: A última pesquisa Real Time Big Data sobre a disputa Lula x Flávio antes do segundo turno
item.description: The Real Time Big Data survey released on October 20 shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 52% of valid votes against Lula's 48%, within the margin of error. The race is technically tied, with 93% of voters decided and similar rejection rates (35% for Lula and 33% for Flávio).

item.title: TSE manda remover posts que ligam Flávio à operação da PF
item.description: The TSE upheld a preliminary injunction ordering the removal of posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the PF's Unha e Carne operation, deeming the accusations lack minimum factual basis. His defense argues he is not investigated, cited, or mentioned, while the PL alleged irregular election propaganda. The decision was unanimous.

item.title: Os bastidores de pedido de CPMI sobre filho de Lula na reta final da eleição
item.description: Federal deputy Coronel Fernanda (PL-MT) leads an initiative to create a CPI investigating President Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, and businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, with support from 92 deputies and 34 senators. The commission aims to investigate suspicions of influence trafficking, corruption and conflicts of interest, but still needs more signatures and the support of the Congress president to be installed.

item.title: Exército do Lula: canal de Janones chega a 6 milhões de seguidores
item.description: The WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', managed by federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG), surpassed 6 million followers on October 20, 2026, mobilizing supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for re-election. Janones encouraged mass sharing of content and set a goal of 7 million followers by October 21, promising to mathematically prove Lula's victory.

item.title: Comitê da Meta aponta falhas de moderação nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: Meta's Oversight Committee flagged recurring moderation failures during elections in Brazil and the U.S., citing both overly strict and insufficient enforcement of fraud policies. The body criticized restrictions on campaign ads involving Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, raising concerns about platform impartiality.

item.title: Lula confirma PEC da Tarifa Zero; Flávio tem apoio de sertanejos
item.description: Lula confirmed he will send a PEC to establish free public transport and emphasized expanding the Pé-de-Meia program to university students during campaign events in the Northeast and Center-West. He also urged non-voters from the first round to participate in the elections.

item.title: Nunes Marques nega que TSE tenha participado de mudança de locais de votação
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, denied that the court participated in changing voting locations for the 2026 election runoff, stating this responsibility belongs to state electoral courts. He emphasized that changes occur due to issues identified in the first round, such as structural damage and landslides caused by rains. Nunes Marques also explained that the initial discrepancy of 4,000 sections reduced to 102 locations was due to an outdated electronic system.

item.title: PL aciona TSE contra Lula por abuso no uso de dados oficiais do governo para enviar mensagens
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL) filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting the disqualification of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's candidacy (PT) for alleged misuse of official government data to send mass messages via WhatsApp promoting social programs and benefits during the electoral period. The lawsuit also seeks a preliminary injunction to halt new message dispatches and require neutral identification for the official GovBR account. Lawyers allege the government used data from Gov.br, INSS, and Receita Federal to personalize messages about programs such as Bolsa Família, Gás do Povo, Luz do Povo, and Farmácia Popular, constituting abuse of political, economic, and authority power.

item.title: As pesquisas e a guerra de quem promete mais na reta final da disputa entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: In the final stretch of the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, both candidates intensify their campaign with economic promises that may increase the fiscal deficit. Among the most prominent measures is the forgiveness of debts for individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs), with an estimated fiscal impact of R$3 billion over three years, although polls show broad acceptance among voters from both sides. Analysts warn of the political and fiscal costs of these electoral actions.

item.title: Flávio vai ao TSE contra disparos em massa de WhatsApp pelo governo Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a lawsuit at the TSE requesting the annulment of Lula's ticket over alleged use of WhatsApp to promote government programs during the electoral period, violating institutional advertising rules. The campaign alleges abuse of power and seeks immediate suspension of messages and penalties against the president and his officials.

item.title: Nordeste concentra 40% das mudanças nos locais de votação no segundo turno
item.description: TSE president minister Kassio Nunes Marques announced that 102 polling locations were changed for the second round of elections, with 40% of these changes concentrated in the Northeast region. The changes were recorded by the regional electoral courts and will take effect on Sunday (25).

item.title: Roger Waters chama Flávio de “babaca” e declara apoio a Lula
item.description: Roger Waters, former Pink Floyd member, declared support for Lula's reelection and harshly criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him a 'bastard'. The musician emphasized voter participation and referenced the assassination of Marielle Franco as a reason to vote for Lula.

item.title: Conselho da Meta vê falhas e cobra regras claras nas eleições
item.description: Meta's Oversight Board flagged recurring content moderation flaws during elections and urged clearer, more transparent rules. The board criticized technical restrictions and overly strict fraud policies that impacted campaigns of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro. It called for public metrics to assess the effectiveness of moderation efforts and safeguard electoral integrity.

item.title: Nunes Marques: TSE não tem nenhuma participação na alteração dos locais de votação
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kássio Nunes Marques, stated that the court has no involvement in changing voting locations. He emphasized the judiciary's independence in this matter.

item.title: Lula vai propor direcionar 25% das emendas obrigatórias para financiar tarifa zero
item.description: President Lula proposes a constitutional amendment to allocate 25% of mandatory budget amendments to fund free urban public transport on weekends, fulfilling a campaign promise.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que eleitor dele que quiser votar em Flávio vai ‘pagar mico’ e ‘perder tempo’
item.description: Renan Santos stated that Missão voters supporting Flávio Bolsonaro will 'pay embarrassment' and waste time, criticizing Pablo Marçal's Hitler comparisons. The candidate indicated he will not vote or cast a null vote in the second round, rejecting Flávio's approach and institutional strategies. The statements sparked mutual criticism between the campaigns.

item.title: Flávio pede ao STF acesso a inquérito sobre lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: The lawyers of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a petition at the Supreme Federal Court to access the investigation in which he is suspected of money laundering. The case is under review by Minister Alexandre de Moraes and involves lawyer Willer Tomaz de Souza.

item.title: Campanha de Lula lança novo jingle: “Flávio, abre o sigilo”
item.description: Lula's campaign released a jingle urging Flávio Bolsonaro to open his bank, tax, and phone records during events in Juazeiro and Petrolina. The move aims for greater transparency after Lula authorized the release of his own and his family's sealed information.

item.title: PF pede mais prazo para aprofundar investigações sobre Lulinha e Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: The Federal Police requested an extension to deepen investigations into Fábio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and Roberta Luchsinger, accused of influence trafficking. The inquiries, analyzed by the STF, investigate alleged intermediation of contracts with public power. The defenses have not yet commented.

item.title: TSE ouve Meta e campanhas de Flávio e Lula sobre distribuição de conteúdo
item.description: The TSE held a meeting with Meta and the campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula to ensure transparency and equality in content distribution and advertising, particularly regarding AI-generated content. Meta was ordered to treat both campaigns equally following accusations of censorship against Lula's campaign.

item.title: Gilmar e Hugo Motta defendem preservação das instituições democráticas na reta final do segundo turno
item.description: Gilmar Mendes and Hugo Motta defended the preservation of democratic institutions and the Rule of Law following the presidential runoff, emphasizing dialogue between government branches and the integrity of the electoral system. Both highlighted the importance of the 1988 Constitution and society in keeping Brazilian democracy strong and resilient.

item.title: Presidente do TSE diz que mudanças em locais de votação do primeiro para o segundo turno caíram em relação a 2022
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, reported that changes to voting locations between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections decreased by 94% compared to 2022. He emphasized that these adjustments are decided by regional electoral courts, not the TSE. He also noted that data may be updated until election day in case of unforeseen circumstances.

item.title: Conselho da Meta aponta falhas recorrentes em moderação eleitoral no Brasil
item.description: Meta's Oversight Board flagged recurring flaws in electoral content moderation in Brazil, citing the suspension of President Lula's ad account due to misapplied anti-fraud mechanisms. Meta acknowledged global technical errors but faced allegations of electoral interference from Lula's supporters, who claim bias toward Flávio Bolsonaro. The incident intensified debates on transparency and free speech on digital platforms during elections.

item.title: Petistas fazem bullying com Felca no Dia de Combate ao Bullying
item.description: Influencer Felca released a video about social phobia and bullying he experienced in school, coinciding with the Anti-Bullying Day. Lulista supporters used the content to attack Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming that PT militants had bullied Felca.

item.title: Lula visita Sarney após ato no Maranhão; veja fotos
item.description: President Lula visited former President José Sarney in São Luís after a campaign walk in Maranhão, three days after Sarney was discharged following surgery. The visit included First Lady Janja and reinforced regional alliances ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Gilmar diz que democracia brasileira serve de exemplo ao mundo
item.description: Justice Minister Gilmar Mendes emphasized the strength of Brazilian democracy at the opening of the 29th International Congress of Constitutional Law of IDP, stating that Brazil serves as an example to the world and highlighting society's role in preserving democratic achievements. He also addressed the electoral process, describing it as a symbolic moment for democracy, and noted challenges such as the full implementation of social rights outlined in the 1988 Constitution.

item.title: PF diz que amigo de Flávio Bolsonaro pagou por remoção de notícias
item.description: Federal Police investigate lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, for allegedly paying a company to remove news articles about both from search results. The case is part of an investigation filed with the Supreme Federal Court under Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The probe suggests an online content manipulation operation.
